title: Corrected Newton mechanism campaign: frozen validation and 48-hour evidence budget
body:
User-approved implementation and bounded run: Test the mechanism without protecting the hypothesis. Authoritative repo /home/sayuj/life. Replaces superseded t_d4e39429; historical reading t_40524ff0 is withdrawn as a physical result (AUDIT_LEDGER R-7 iv).

Implemented separate corrected-material runner, exact shake endpoint, 3 matched 12-month diagnostics, full 180-month dt/iteration/mesh matrix plus combined refinement, and 252 CPU comparator cases. Frozen protocol: reports/newton_mechanism_campaign_2026-09-12/PREREG.md and protocol.json. Source/protocol seals; 48 active-hour total budget includes CPU, failed and interrupted work; GPU exclusion 23:00–01:00 IST; memory admission/stop gates. No services, manuscript or historical results changed. All 63 targeted tests pass. Two-step CUDA smoke is finite but has transient 1.00418% axial strain; unchanged 1% gate and validation-only status documented before the campaign.

This is a manually owned, non-spawnable gpt-astra card. Do not dispatch an agent, load a model, modify the sealed campaign or create subtasks. The standalone controller heartbeats and returns this card for review with final status. Live report: /home/sayuj/life/results/newton_mechanism_campaign_2026-09-12/REPORT.md. Incomplete, budget-limited or mechanically invalid evidence cannot count as successful convergence. No biological winner from synthetic ordering.
